Engine: 'Allah' = 3ala (41:54, 42:18, 43:28); 'Shalina' = 5allina; 'hawaii' = awaa3i; 'befawwer' = bey5awwef; 'taman' = kaman (45:13); 'Ma li one' = laymoon; 'el zahar' = el-z8aar; '10' at 16:18 = his number for two. 06:57 ما خططت was right - Amal misheard مخطط and confirmed ما خططت (08:04), not a slip. Self-fixes skipped: 00:46 بصوت عالي, 10:09 واحدة, 10:36 بنطلون أزرق, 20:09 حلو, 39:31 بدنا, 42:18 3ala aa5er, 52:21 تروحي, 55:27 el-Halloween. 26:11 matlube for ma2loobe and 35:01 طريا = S4. 19:10 سمك is likely English 'sumac' heard as fish. 1:00:30 'ishi iltani?' was a question (not scored).

rows.medi_said: أكل الـ مف-- no، مفض-- ... أكل المفضل، مفضل الأكل. No، أكل المفضل.

kul + bare noun = every; he meant all Palestinian food; Amal said 'Every' and he fixed to kol el akel el Filastini (24:26).
Feminine ending on the adjective for masculine akel; Amal let it pass (Latin engine text).

rows.medi_said: Uh, shu ism el akel, uh, khadra akhtar, uh, akle

rows.medi_said: No, hadi kaman il kaman akli.

rows.proposed_rule: kaman before a noun = another / more; for 'also' put kaman at the end of the sentence: hadi aklet 5atibti el-mufaddale kamaan
rows.why: kaman before the noun means 'another'; for 'also' Amal moved it to the end.

rows.amal_said: How about a cleaner version? هذي أكلة خطيبتي المفضلة. ... (31:39) No. You would have to link خطيبتي. يعني لا خطيبتي or عند خطيبتي.
